model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of six categories of semantic relations. The chart contains six slices, each representing a different type of relation: Conjunctive, Disjunctive, Approximate Quantities, Absolute Absence, Comparative Relationships, and Universal Quantifiers. The slices are colored light blue, light orange, light green, light red, light turquoise, and light purple, respectively. The proportions shown are as follows: Conjunctive represents 50.49%, Disjunctive represents 49.51%, Approximate Quantities represents 45.03%, Absolute Absence represents 18.71%, Comparative Relationships represents 36.26%, and Universal Quantifiers represents 29.07%. Percentage labels are included within each slice. The slices appear to be visually ordered in a clockwise direction, generally from the largest to the smallest proportions. A legend is present, labeling each category and its corresponding color.
